phase3_findings.description: MemoryStore.set_groups with an empty sequence strips group keys from the merged dict, but Chroma merges metadata on update, so old memory_groups/memory_tagged remain and the call silently does nothing; latent (no current caller passes an empty list).
_NewItem (importer.py) and DedupEntry (store.py) carry kind separately from the payload, so a mismatched kind/payload pair can be constructed; latent.

get_memory_stats omits from unretrievable_count a record marked tagged whose group list is unreadable (record_groups returns []), though no request can retrieve it; list_memories/get_memory show it as groups: [].
